```plato
    // A concentrated nodal force resolved onto the three degrees of freedom of
    // its node.
    LoadContributions(f: NodalForce3D): Array<DofLoad>
        => [
            DofLoad(DofIndex(f.Node.Value * 3), f.Force.X),
            DofLoad(DofIndex(f.Node.Value * 3 + 1), f.Force.Y),
            DofLoad(DofIndex(f.Node.Value * 3 + 2), f.Force.Z)];
```

## Line 471

```plato
    // A uniform traction over one boundary triangle shared equally among its
    // three nodes — again exact rather than lumped, for the same reason: a linear
    // triangle's shape functions each integrate to a third of its area.
    LoadContributions(t: FaceTraction3D, positions: Array<Point3D>): Array<DofLoad>
    {
        var share = t.Face.ToTriangle3D(positions).Area / 3.0;
        var nodes = t.Face.Vertices;
        return 9.MapRange(k =>
            DofLoad(DofIndex(nodes[k / 3].Value * 3 + k % 3), t.Traction.At(k % 3) * share));
    }
```

```plato
    // Every load on the model resolved into degree-of-freedom contributions:
    // nodal forces, then the body force of gravity, then the boundary tractions.
    LoadContributions(model: ElasticModel3D): Array<DofLoad>
        => model.Forces.FlatMap(f => f.LoadContributions)
            .Concatenate(model.Mesh.Cells.FlatMap(c =>
                c.GravityContributions(model.Mesh.Positions, model.Material.Density,
                    model.Gravity)))
            .Concatenate(model.Tractions.FlatMap(t =>
                t.LoadContributions(model.Mesh.Positions)));
```

```plato
    LoadContributions(model: ElasticModel2D): Array<DofLoad>
        => model.Forces.FlatMap(f => f.LoadContributions)
            .Concatenate(model.Mesh.Faces.FlatMap(f =>
```

```plato

    // One beam load resolved into the degrees of freedom it acts on: a point
    // force onto the deflection of the nearest node, a moment onto that node's
    // rotation, and a distributed force onto the four degrees of freedom of every
    // element it covers.
    LoadContributions(load: BeamLoad, b: Beam, elementCount: Integer): Array<DofLoad>
        => match (load)
        {
            PointForce(position, magnitude) =>
                [DofLoad(DofIndex(b.BeamNearestNode(elementCount, position) * 2), magnitude)];
            DistributedForce(start, end, magnitude) =>
                b.BeamDistributedContributions(elementCount, start, end, magnitude);
            Moment(position, magnitude) =>
                [DofLoad(DofIndex(b.BeamNearestNode(elementCount, position) * 2 + 1), magnitude)];
        };
```
